title: tte
description: Time to exhaustion at a power the CALLER names (#187), from the same CP model `power-curve` publishes. `status` is the honest qualifier: `in_model` (2-20 minutes, where the two-parameter model holds), `outside_model` (the number is real arithmetic but the model overshoots there — read it as a direction), or `below_cp` (at or under CP the model says indefinitely, which is the model's answer and not the athlete's). `cp`, `w_prime`, `fit_points` and `window_days` travel with it because a fit from three close-together bests is a different claim from one fitted on a wide curve.
